body:
I have smoked Wild Dagga cigarettes on several occasions and the effects are so low they are barley out of the threshold stage. I've tried smoking the leaves and the flowers and they both are about the same for me. I've even tried smoking 2 cigarettes in a row and still nothing except a headache the next day. If you are thinking about trying this, don't. Smoke tobacco or weed instead, this is a waste of money.
